name: Player Name
note: Copy this file per player and fill it in by hand. 'stats' takes 2-4 [label, value] pairs. Optional: 'photo' (cutout PNG; default <profile paths.headshot_cutouts>/<num>.png), 'count': false (no count-up), 'logo': false (hide the profile logo). Render: python3 engine/statcard.py <this file> <out dir> --profile <name>
